verdict.rationale: Activepieces is open-source (MIT) and self-hostable via Docker, and exposes an API with API-key auth that could be used to pull data out, which supports data portability in principle. However there is no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export all your data/flows in an open format' feature or migration tooling. missing for 10: dedicated data-export feature docs, documented open export format (e.g. JSON flow export/import), independent confirmation of a full data-portability workflow.
